**Test Assist** — capture, annotate and export QA defect evidence.

### Desktop app (Windows)

Download `TestAssist-*-win64.zip`, unzip it anywhere, and run `TestAssist.exe`.
No Python installation required. To keep it to hand, right-click the exe and
choose **Pin to taskbar**.

The app lives in the system tray with a floating capture launcher that stays
above whatever you are testing.

### Browser build

No install at all: **https://emil3663.github.io/test-assist/**

The browser build runs the same capture → annotate → export loop. `README.md`
sets out exactly what each build does, and what only the desktop one does.
